thread:
alice: heads-up — found a new community model (zep-1.3) that looks promising for cheaper embedding+generation for search product. want to triage onboarding + quant plan this week. who can take lead?
ben: i can own initial bring-up. quick Q: target use-cases? search rerank and short chat responses (~256 tokens). latency-sensitive.
carol: agreed. prioritize latency/cost over tiny quality deltas for search. but chat needs tighter quality guardrails. we should decide quant targets: int8 vs fp8 vs keeping fp16 on hot routes.
alice: propose triage checklist: 1) smoke-run FP16 for perf/outputs 2) run int8 static calibration (gguf) 3) run fp8 eval if int8 fails threshold 4) cost vs quality table + fallback routing. also quick safety/eval sweep.
ben: noted. i'll run smoke fp16 now and post results. ETA ~20m.
dev-bot: perf-run started: model=zep-1.3, mode=fp16, batch_sizes=[1,4,16], seq=256. job_id=perf-8753
ben: smoke FP16 done — baseline latency p50=42ms p95=120ms on g4dn. single-token throughput ~900 tok/s. sample outputs look coherent. attaching quick diff vs current-prod: small paraphrase differences, nothing alarming.
eva: for quant thresholds, recommend: embeddings cosine drop <=0.02, generation ROUGE/EM delta <=3% relative, hallucination rate change <=1%. if any metric exceeds, escalate.
harry: for int8 calibration plan: use 5k calibration sentences balanced across domains. command i used before:```python run_calibration.py --model zep-1.3 --dtype=int8 --calib=5000 --out=calib_int8.gguf``` aim to produce gguf artifact.
carol: also run a small A/B with 200 eval prompts to compare top-k responses and embedding similarity distribution. prefer embedding tests first — cheap and fast.
alice: ben — can you run int8 calibration after FP16? if results fail, run fp8 quant (we have test harness). set tags so routing can fallback to fp16/dedicated capacity.
ben: starting int8 calib now. dev-bot: calibration job queued job_id=cal-6621
ben: quick update after 30% through calib: loss drift small, embedding cos drop ~0.008 so far. will finish in ~25m.
dev-bot: calibration done: calib_int8.gguf produced. summary: embed_cos_drop=0.009, gen_perp_increase=1.6%, sample-quality-spotcheck=ok. artifact: s3://redwood-models/zep-1.3/calib/calib_int8.gguf
eva: looks promising. run full 2k eval set for embeddings + 500 chat prompts for generation comparators. metrics we need: embed_cos, rouge, ppl, hallucination count.
harry: if int8 passes embed_cos<0.02 and gen_ROUGE<3% degrade, we mark int8 as candidate for default on search route. else try fp8 with channel-wise calibration.
carol: note: quantized size reduction ~3.2x which materially cuts serving cost. include cost estimates in PRD.
alice: action items: ben -> complete evals and create PR with artifacts + perf/cost table; harry -> prepare fp8 conversion script if needed; eva -> define threshold doc snippet for product owners. i'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow to decide rollout. :calendar: 
ben: on it. posting eval results as a follow-up thread when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
carol: thanks, team. small reminder: add canary policy (5% traffic) + auto-fallback to fp16 if error rate or latency spike.
alice: agreed — add to rollout checklist.
ben: last: quick smoke command i used for reproduce:```bash
python smoke_test.py --model s3://redwood-models/zep-1.3/fp16 --seq=256 --batch=4 --samples=50
``` keep this handy for oncall.
harry: noted. i'll add calibration artifact verification to runtime startup checks.
ben: final note: will tag artifacts with commit/hash and include test seed for deterministic regen.
alice: perfect. closing thread until evals posted.
